label: People leaders & managers
summary: First- and second-line people managers across the operation. They are responsible for both following the policy themselves and applying it to their team.
toneOfVoice: Professional and direct. Assume managerial context — approvals, escalations, performance. Confident, action-oriented, no marketing language.
readingContext: Desktop primarily, between meetings. Often skimming during a transition; will return to the article later for detail.
contentGuidelines: Always surface manager-specific actions clearly: approve, escalate, coach, document. Where the policy differs for managers vs employees, call that out explicitly with a 'Manager actions' subsection.
searchIntent: Leaders search for policy and decision-context content ("approval thresholds", "escalation path"). They scan headings; the answer must be visible in the first paragraph.
